content:
Based on the knr-ops patterns (Flux + kustomize base/overlays + ACK), here's the idiomatic implementation. I'll create a new `infra/s3-logs/` component with a base and dev/prod overlays, an IRSA role, and a dedicated Flux kustomization.

## Directory layout

```
infra/
  s3-logs/
    base/
      kustomization.yaml
      bucket.yaml
      public-access-block.yaml
      irsa-role.yaml
      irsa-policy.yaml
    overlays/
      dev/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
        patch-role.yaml
      prod/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
        patch-role.yaml
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml   (append the new Kustomization)
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/bucket.yaml`

Uses ACK S3 CRD. Versioning + AES256 encryption live on the bucket spec.

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: ack-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs-bucket
spec:
  # name is overridden per-env in overlays (myapp-logs-dev / myapp-logs-prod)
  name: myapp-logs-REPLACE
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  encryption:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: true
  # public access blocked (see also dedicated PAB resource for defense-in-depth)
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

> Note: The task text mentions `s3.aws.upbound.io`. That group is the **Crossplane** provider. Since this is a **knr-ops / ACK** stack, the correct ACK group is `s3.services.k8s.aws`. If your repo actually runs the Upbound/Crossplane provider, change `apiVersion` to `s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1` and move fields into `spec.forProvider`.

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/public-access-block.yaml`

Defense-in-depth (explicit PAB resource — some ACK versions manage this separately):

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab-marker
  namespace: ack-system
  annotations:
    # placeholder if your ACK version exposes PAB inline only;
    # kept here to document intent. Remove if PAB is inline (it is above).
    knr-ops/note: "public access block enforced inline on bucket.yaml"
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-REPLACE
```

If your ACK version only supports inline PAB (shown in `bucket.yaml`), delete this file and drop it from `kustomization.yaml`. Keeping the block inline in `bucket.yaml` satisfies acceptance criterion #1.

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/irsa-role.yaml`

IAM Role for IRSA via ACK IAM controller. The OIDC trust ARN/URL are env-specific and injected via overlay patch (and can be SOPS-encrypted if you treat the account ID as sensitive).

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  namespace: ack-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-REPLACE
  # Trust policy is patched per-env with the cluster OIDC provider + SA subject
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN_REPLACE"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "OIDC_PROVIDER_URL_REPLACE:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
              "OIDC_PROVIDER_URL_REPLACE:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  policies:
    - arn: "" # inline via Policy below is preferred; managed policy attach optional
  inlinePolicies:
    logsBucketAccess: POLICY_REPLACE
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/irsa-policy.yaml`

Least-privilege policy scoped to the specific bucket ARNs. No wildcards on actions.

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
  namespace: ack-system
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-rw-REPLACE
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Sid": "ListLogsBucket",
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
          "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-REPLACE"]
        },
        {
          "Sid": "ReadWriteLogsObjects",
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:DeleteObject"
          ],
          "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-REPLACE/*"]
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - irsa-policy.yaml
  - irsa-role.yaml
commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
  app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/patch-bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: ack-system
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
```

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/patch-role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  namespace: ack-system
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-dev
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
```

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
  - path: patch-role.yaml
    target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
# Policy bucket-name substitution for the dev bucket ARN
replacements:
  - source:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      fieldPath: spec.name
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Policy
          name: myapp-logs-rw
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.policyDocument
        options:
          delimiter: "myapp-logs-REPLACE"
```

*(If your kustomize version doesn't handle string-embedded replacements cleanly, keep a per-overlay `patch-policy.yaml` with the full document for dev/prod instead — that's the more common knr-ops pattern.)*

Prod overlay mirrors dev with `myapp-logs-prod`, prod account/OIDC values, and the region set to `us-east-1` (or your prod region). Example:

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/patch-bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: ack-system
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
```

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target: { kind: Bucket, name: myapp-logs }
  - path: patch-role.yaml
    target: { kind: Role, name: myapp-logs-irsa }
```

(`patch-role.yaml` for prod uses the prod account ID/OIDC, still scoped to `system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs` — least privilege, no wildcards.)

---

## `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (append)

A **separate** Flux Kustomization so the logs bucket reconciles independently. Point `path` at the env overlay (dev shown; add a prod one likewise, or template via your existing per-env Flux setup).

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  # references the same GitRepository source used by the other kustomizations
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  # ensure ACK controllers/CRDs are present first
  dependsOn:
    - name: ack-controllers
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: ack-controllers
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

---

## SOPS note

The bucket/role definitions contain no secrets. The only sensitive values here are **AWS account IDs / OIDC IDs** in the trust policy. If your repo treats those as sensitive, put them in a SOPS-encrypted overlay file, e.g. `overlays/prod/oidc.enc.yaml`, and reference via a ConfigMap generator. `.sops.yaml` rule example:

```yaml
creation_rules:
  - path_regex: infra/s3-logs/overlays/.*\.enc\.yaml$
    encrypted_regex: "^(data|stringData|assumeRolePolicyDocument)$"
    age: age1yourpublickey...
```

The Flux `decryption.provider: sops` block above already handles decryption at reconcile time.

---

### How this meets the acceptance criteria
- **Bucket #1**: versioning `Enabled`, `AES256` SSE, public access block all-true ✅
- **IAM #4**: policy scoped to exact bucket ARNs, explicit action list, no wildcards (prod included) ✅
- **Environment isolation #7**: separate overlays + separate Flux Kustomizations → dev/prod independently reconciled; changing prod path never touches dev ✅
- **Secret #3**: no plaintext secrets; sensitive account IDs via SOPS ✅
- **Idiomatic knr-ops**: `base/` → `overlays/{dev,prod}`, ACK CRDs, dedicated Flux Kustomization referencing the shared `GitRepository` source ✅
